authoredNote: Expectations written from the graph contract this lane already holds (ONE edge per `type|source|target`) plus the measurement that made the projection lossy: the grammar-derived oracle counts a name read at more than one site over the 6,439-file corpus as 2,218 names in 2,354 files, 4,273 sites. The `line_number` pins assert the pre-existing convention — the LAST collected site — is unchanged, and the `meta.templateReadLines` pins assert the new list. Line pins read off the post-fix run and checked against the fixture's text.
rationale: JOB 2 of the svelte ontology pass. The collection map was `Map<string, number>`, so `out.set(word, line)` overwrote and every read site but the last was unrecoverable from the payload. That is a lossy PROJECTION rather than a wrong edge — every claimed line is a real read site — which is why no gate saw it: a differential compares one edge per pair, and the edge was right. The fix records every site in `metadata.templateReadLines` and leaves `line_number` and `confidence` exactly as they were, so no field a shared payload baseline pins moves. `snapped` and `promise` are the single-site controls: a rule that invented sites would show up there.
